summary: Covers manufacturers of soft drinks, juices, bottled water, tea, coffee and other non-alcoholic beverages. Disclosures address fleet fuel, energy, water, health and nutrition, product labelling and marketing, packaging lifecycle, and ingredient supply chain impacts and sourcing.

questions.text: How much fleet fuel did your organisation consume, and what percentage was renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) fleet fuel consumed in GJ and (2) the percentage of that fuel that is renewable.

questions.text: What are (1) the operational energy consumed, (2) the percentage of that energy that is grid electricity and (3) the percentage that is renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) operational energy consumed in GJ, (2) the percentage supplied as grid electricity and (3) the percentage that is renewable.

questions.text: What are (1) the total water withdrawn and (2) the total water consumed, and what percentage of each is in regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress?
questions.hint: Unit: Thousand cubic metres (m³), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total water withdrawn and (2) total water consumed in thousand m3, and the percentage of each located in regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress.

questions.text: What water management risks does your organisation face, and what strategies and practices do you use to mitigate them?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the main water management risks and the strategies and practices used to mitigate them, including any targets and performance against them.

questions.text: What revenue does your organisation earn from (1) zero- and low-calorie or energy-free and low-energy, (2) no-added-sugar and (3) artificially sweetened beverages?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report revenue separately for (1) zero- and low-calorie or energy-free and low-energy, (2) no-added-sugar and (3) artificially sweetened beverages, in your presentation currency.

parts.label: Zero- and low-calorie or energy-free and low-energy

questions.text: How does your organisation identify and manage products and ingredients related to nutritional and health concerns among consumers?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the process to identify and manage products and ingredients of nutritional or health concern, including reformulation, labelling and portfolio decisions.

questions.text: What percentage of your advertising impressions were (1) made on children and (2) made on children promoting products that meet dietary guidelines?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report (1) the percentage of advertising impressions made on children and (2) the percentage of those that promote products meeting dietary guidelines. State the guidelines and age threshold used.

questions.text: What revenue does your organisation earn from products labelled as (1) containing genetically modified organisms (GMOs) and (2) non-GMO?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report (1) revenue from products labelled as containing GMOs and (2) revenue from products labelled non-GMO, each in your presentation currency.

questions.text: How many incidents of non-compliance with industry or regulatory labelling or marketing codes did your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of incidents of non-compliance with industry or regulatory labelling or marketing codes in the reporting period.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with marketing or labelling practices?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses (fines, settlements, damages) from legal proceedings related to marketing or labelling practices, in your presentation currency.

questions.text: What are (1) the total weight of your packaging, (2) the percentage made from recycled or renewable materials and (3) the percentage that is recyclable, reusable or compostable?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total packaging weight in metric tonnes, (2) the percentage made from recycled or renewable materials and (3) the percentage that is recyclable, reusable or compostable.

questions.text: What strategies does your organisation use to reduce the environmental impact of its packaging throughout its lifecycle?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe strategies to reduce packaging impacts across the lifecycle, such as material reduction, redesign, recycled content, and end-of-life recovery, with any targets.

disclosures.title: Environmental & Social Impacts of Ingredient Supply Chain

questions.text: What were your suppliers' social and environmental responsibility audit (1) non-conformance rate and (2) associated corrective action rate for (a) major and (b) minor non-conformances?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report (1) the non-conformance rate and (2) the associated corrective action rate from supplier social and environmental audits, each split into (a) major and (b) minor non-conformances.

questions.text: What percentage of your beverage ingredients, by cost, is sourced from regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by cost · Report the percentage of beverage ingredients, by cost, (by cost or as specified) sourced from regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress.

questions.text: What are your priority ingredients, and what sourcing risks related to environmental and social considerations do they present?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · List the priority ingredients and discuss the environmental and social sourcing risks for each, and how you manage them.

questions.text: What was the volume of products you sold?
questions.hint: Unit: Millions of hectoliters (Mhl) · Report the volume of products sold in millions of hectolitres (Mhl).

questions.text: How many production facilities does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of production facilities.

questions.text: What was the total fleet road distance travelled by your organisation?
questions.hint: Unit: Kilometres (km) · Report total fleet road kilometres travelled in the reporting period.
